evidence: On fair per-positive negatives, a 70/30 rank blend of disease degree and the IDF-SVD ensemble reaches macro AUPRC 0.7747 / micro 0.7732
observation: On fair per-positive negatives a 70/30 rank blend of disease degree and the IDF-SVD ensemble reached 0.7747 macro/0.7732 micro, above degree alone at 0.7354/0.7087 and the SVD alone at 0.5434/0.6088. F-0039 records the degree-aware blend as the fair-protocol candidate.
subject: F-46
title: Degree plus SVD blend wins the fair suite
